entry.title: New: Resolution 415 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR MULTI-YEAR LEASES FOR ONE FORKLIFT, ONE 3-TON DUMP TRUCK, AND ONE SUPER DUTY TRUCK WITH UTILITY BODY AND CRANE FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into five-year lease agreements with an approximate monthly cost of $1,600 for the forklift, $2,200 for the 3-ton dump truck, and $5,100 for the super duty truck, to be used by the Wastewater Division.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 415-24 & FC-134 - 02/07/24
